items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Was it Mickey Marker? No, Mickey was a piano player.

ctx.x: I never did hear him play violin. No. I don't guess he made a good record. No, he never even made a good record. Was he a hot violin player? Yeah. A straight man. Hot, he got all the way. Did they have many hot violin players there?
They had a few of them. They had this... Was it Mickey Marker? No, Mickey was a piano player. Yeah, a piano player. Which one was it? Oscar.
